criteria.statement: Kind 30100 Loom status events decode required job and status tags into a typed Loom job-status projection.
Kind 5101 Loom result events decode success, exit code, duration, artifact URLs, errors, and worker provenance into a typed Loom job-result projection.
Kind 5102 Loom cancellation events decode job correlation, requester, worker target, and reason into a typed Loom cancellation projection.
